subject: Compliance discovery: Pathfinder Health — SOC 2 / ISO / vendor Qs & next steps
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@pathfinder-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Compliance discovery: Pathfinder Health — SOC 2 / ISO / vendor Qs & next steps

Thanks again for the 30-minute intro earlier, Anna — good to meet you. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track items: 

- Pathfinder context: you described a phased procurement window targeting Q1 2027 production launch for patient-facing summarization features.
- Compliance priorities you highlighted: SOC 2 (Type II preferred, current audit in progress but not yet complete), HIPAA alignment, and an interest in ISO 27001 for international partners.
- You asked for an initial vendor security questionnaire and a scoped proposal showing what Redwood would put into scope for SOC 2 and what would be left out (e.g., analytics sandbox vs. PHI-processing services).

What I attached: a blank vendor questionnaire (pathfinder_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf) to start, and an initial SOC 2 scope workbook (soc2-scope-proposal.xlsx) — both are rough and intended to accelerate the back-and-forth.

Proposed next steps: 
1) You and your security/IT contact (procurement@pathfinder-health.com) complete the questionnaire — answer high-level controls and call out any redlines.
2) Rishi will follow up with a short SOC 2 intake: we'll propose a minimal scope for the features you plan to use in prod (we believe we can keep PHI-handling services isolated).
3) Marissa will prepare a high-level cost estimate for a dedicated support plan tied to accelerated audit evidence collection (if you want Redwood to provide evidence packages).
4) Schedule a 30-minute intake call week of Nov 23 to align on outstanding items and timeline.

If that looks right, can you confirm who from Pathfinder will take the questionnaire and whether you prefer a Nov 23 or Nov 24 slot for the intake call?

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pathfinder_vendor_questionnaire_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
Attachment: soc2-scope-proposal.xlsx (XLSX, 22KB)

From: Anna Klein <anna.klein@pathfinder-health.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pathfinder-health.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance discovery: Pathfinder Health — SOC 2 / ISO / vendor Qs & next steps

Thanks, Laura — the recap is helpful. I'll be the primary on the questionnaire but I'll need input from our infra lead (Marcus Tran) for network controls and from Legal for any contract-level items. A couple of clarifications from my side: 

- SOC 2: we are aiming for controls in place by end of Q1; the final decision on whether Redwood needs to be fully in-scope vs. partially-scoped will depend on the SOC evidence and whether PHI is stored/processed. Our internal product plan avoids storing PHI at rest, but we do process PHI in transit for certain flows — will need your recommendation on where to draw the scope line.
- HIPAA: we need a BAA on file before any PHI-processing work begins.
- ISO 27001: exploratory for now; this would be Tier 2 for our partners and not a hard requirement for launch.

We prefer Nov 24 for the intake (afternoon). I'll have procurement send their contact for the questionnaire shortly. 

FYI: procurement@pathfinder-health.com will attach the initial questionnaire answers and any supplemental doc requests to the Drive link you shared.

— Anna
Head of Security & Compliance, Pathfinder Health
anna.klein@pathfinder-health.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Klein <anna.klein@pathfinder-health.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, procurement@pathfinder-health.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Compliance discovery: Pathfinder Health — SOC 2 / ISO / vendor Qs & next steps

Great — Nov 24 afternoon locked in. I created a short mutual action plan and an editable MPA draft (redwood_mpa_draft.docx) in the shared Drive; link below for your team to review.

Immediate action items (who/what/when):
- Pathfinder: complete the vendor questionnaire by EOD Nov 27. (owner: Anna / procurement)
- Redwood (Rishi): SOC 2 intake and initial evidence map delivered by Nov 30. This will include a recommended minimal scope for the features you plan to use and a list of artifacts we can produce quickly (logs, RBAC config snapshots, change history).
- Redwood (Marissa): cost options for evidence support and a timeline for an optional accelerated readiness package by Dec 3.

Notes on scoping: our initial read is that we can offer two scoping models — "integration-scoped" (Redwood evidence for APIs and runtime used by Pathfinder only) and "platform-scoped" (broader, includes shared infra). We'll surface tradeoffs in the intake.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Pathfinder-Questionnaire

If anything changes on your side, flag it and we'll adjust the plan prior to the Nov 24 call. Looking forward to the intake.

Laura

Attachment: redwood_mpa_draft.docx (DOCX, 14KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Anna Klein <anna.klein@pathfinder-health.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Compliance discovery: Pathfinder Health — SOC 2 / ISO / vendor Qs & next steps

Forwarding my commitments after reviewing the scope workbook — quick note below.

Laura / Marissa / Anna — I'll own the SOC 2 intake and the evidence map. My plan: 
1) Draft an evidence checklist focused on the integration-scoped approach by Nov 30.
2) Identify any gaps where we do not currently generate artifacts (e.g., business continuity test logs) and propose mitigations or alternative evidence.
3) Provide a short write-up on how Redwood handles ePHI-in-transit patterns and recommended guardrails (tokenization / redaction / dedicated VPC routes) for Pathfinder's flows.

I'll start by pulling the logs and RBAC snapshots and will reach out if I need sample queries from your infra team.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Solutions, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0112
